title: dad_deleted_my_run
display_title: My Dad Called My World Save 'A Waste of Server Money' and Deleted It
beats: My dad paid $6 a month for my Minecraft server, and he never let me forget it.
I'd spent five months building a parkour course in that world, one I was actually proud of, planning to record it for my tiny channel.
Last week he saw my screen time report and said forty hours a month on 'jumping on blocks' was pathetic for a 15 year old.
I said give me one more week to finish the course, then he took my laptop and cancelled the server that same night.
Eleven world saves gone, including the only build I ever finished, and he told me to thank him later for making me 'touch grass.'
Was I wrong to stop speaking to him?
